lines: Chamakte chaand ko toota hua taara bana daala
couplets.en: The shining moon was made into a fallen star.

lines: Meri aawargi ne mujhko aawara bana daala
couplets.en: My wandering left me with nowhere to belong.

lines: Chamakte chaand ko toota hua taara bana daala
couplets.en: The shining moon was made into a fallen star.

lines: Bada dilkash, bada rangeen hai ye shehar, kehte hain
couplets.en: They say this city is lovely and full of color.

lines: Bada dilkash, bada rangeen hai ye shehar, kehte hain
couplets.en: They say this city is lovely and full of color.

lines: Yahaan par hain hazaaron ghar, gharon mein log rehte hain
couplets.en: There are thousands of houses here, and people call them home.

lines: Mujhe is shehar ne galiyon ka banjaara bana daala
couplets.en: This city left me to wander its lanes.

lines: Chamakte chaand ko toota hua taara bana daala
couplets.en: The shining moon was made into a fallen star.

lines: Main is duniya ko aksar dekh kar hairaan hota hoon
couplets.en: I often look at this world in bewilderment.

lines: Main is duniya ko aksar dekh kar hairaan hota hoon
couplets.en: I often look at this world in bewilderment.

lines: Na mujhse ban saka chhota sa ghar, din raat rota hoon
couplets.en: I could scarcely build myself a little home, and I weep day and night.

lines: Khudaya, tune kaise ye jahaan saara bana daala
couplets.en: My God, how did you make this whole world?

lines: Chamakte chaand ko toota hua taara bana daala
couplets.en: The shining moon was made into a fallen star.

lines: Mere maalik, mera dil kyun tadapta hai, sulagta hai
couplets.en: My Lord, why does my heart ache and smolder?

lines: Mere maalik, mera dil kyun tadapta hai, sulagta hai
couplets.en: My Lord, why does my heart ache and smolder?

lines: Teri marzi pe kiska zor chalta hai
couplets.en: Whose will could prevail over yours?

lines: Kisi ko gul, kisi ko tune angaara bana daala
couplets.en: You made one a rose, another a burning coal.

lines: Chamakte chaand ko toota hua sitaara bana daala
couplets.en: The shining moon was made into a fallen star.

lines: Yahi aaghaaz tha mera, yahi anjaam hona tha
couplets.en: This was my beginning, and this was how it had to end.

lines: Yahi aaghaaz tha mera, yahi anjaam hona tha
couplets.en: This was my beginning, and this was how it had to end.

lines: Mujhe barbaad hona tha, mujhe nakaam hona tha
couplets.en: I was bound for ruin, and bound to fail.

lines: Mujhe taqdeer ne taqdeer ka maara bana daala
couplets.en: Fate made me the one to bear its blows.

couplets.en: The shining moon was made into a fallen star.
